marks.gloss_en: תנן רבי שמעון פוטר בזה ובזה -- אלמא נקוב כשאינו נקוב משוי ליה
ורמינהו: רבי שמעון אומר אין בין נקוב לשאינו נקוב אלא להכשיר זרעים בלבד -- so they DO differ, at least there
apparently, R' Shimon treats a perforated pot as an unperforated one
the mishna: R' Shimon exempts one who plucks from a pot, perforated or not
כדדריש רבי שמעון בן מנסיא: ויבן ה' אלהים את הצלע -- the Holy One braided Eve (the text's marker is כדדריש; no SupportKind names it)
וכי דרך בנין בכך? -- is that the way of building?
אין, כדדריש רבי שמעון בן מנסיא -- yes, as R' Shimon ben Menasya expounded (= p_kelia_binyan, supported by s_kedadrish_rsbm)
a woman who paints [her eyes] -- [is liable] on account of dyeing
מאי טעמא דרבי אליעזר -- R' Elazar's account: honeycomb is like a forest (ביערת הדבש), and detaching from a forest is liable
R' Elazar: what is R' Eliezer's reason? as it is written 'and he dipped it in the ya'arat of honey' (I Sam 14:27)
רבך קטיל קני באגמא הוה -- rejects 'milking on account of milking'; unanswered: he went and asked the study hall
רבך קטיל קני באגמא הוה -- rejects 'curdling on account of curdling'; unanswered
רבך קטיל קני באגמא הוה -- rejects 'cheese-making on account of cheese-making'; unanswered
Rav Nachman bar Gurya: one who milks is liable on account of milking
one who milks, one who curdles and one who makes cheese -- [the measure is] a dried-fig's bulk
Ameimar permitted sprinkling [the floor] in Mechoza
it was taught: a wise woman sprinkles her house on Shabbat
